name: WdCompareDestination
description: When comparing two files for differences, specifies whether to create a new file or mark the differences between the two documents in the original document or the revised document.

constants.name: wdCompareDestinationOriginal
constants.description: Tracks the differences between the two files using tracked changes in the original document.

constants.name: wdCompareDestinationRevised
constants.description: Tracks the differences between the two files using tracked changes in the revised document.

constants.name: wdCompareDestinationNew
constants.description: Creates a new file and tracks the differences between the original document and the revised document using tracked changes.
